READ: findings.json
plan.md revised on disk (v1.2) to address finding P6: D8 and P15 now set the transmission boundary. It is a pre-write check that matches aiohttp 3.14.3's only pre-write failures, followed by mark_emitted and ws.send_str, with no await before transport.write (checked in the installed source). Failures after the mark map to acknowledgement_lost. A canary test pins aiohttp's behaviour, with a fallback writer. New tests cover a pre-write failure, cancellation and a deadline before the frame leaves, and an interruption after the write. Step ids are unchanged.
